ei.title: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

fullPassage:
Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

questions.passage: Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its (A)[uniqueness / ordinariness] often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two (B)[distinct / identical] Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong. Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and (C)[effectively / ineffectively] push back enemies with fewer soldiers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수원 화성은 유네스코 세계문화유산으로 당당히 서 있지만, 그 독특함은 종종 간과된다. 이 성곽은 두 가지 구별되는 한국 양식을 교묘하게 융합한다. 방어자들은 높은 곳에서 싸우며 적은 병력으로 적을 효과적으로 물리칠 수 있었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① uniqueness(독특함) - distinct(구별되는) - effectively(효과적으로): 화성의 특별함과 두 양식의 차이, 산성의 방어 이점을 설명하는 맥락
❌ ordinariness(평범함): 화성의 독특함이 간과된다는 문맥
❌ identical(동일한): 산성과 읍성은 서로 다른 양식
❌ ineffectively(비효과적으로): 높은 곳의 방어 이점을 설명하는 맥락
det.tip: uniqueness ↔ ordinariness, distinct ↔ identical은 빈출 반의어 쌍입니다.

questions.passage: Living in the sanseong was not (A)[practical / ideal] due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed (B)[administrative / residential] buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they (C)[withdrew / advanced] to the nearby sanseong for safety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 산성에서의 생활은 부족한 농지와 열악한 생활 조건 때문에 실용적이지 않았다. 읍성 안에는 행정 건물, 학습 시설, 군사 훈련장이 있었다. 전쟁 시 백성들은 근처 산성으로 철수했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② practical(실용적인) - administrative(행정의) - withdrew(철수했다): 산성 거주의 비실용성, 읍성의 행정 기능, 전시 대피를 설명
❌ ideal(이상적인): not practical이 원문
❌ residential(주거의): 행정 건물이 원문
❌ advanced(전진했다): 안전을 위해 후퇴한 것
det.tip: withdrew는 withdraw(철수하다)의 과거형입니다. withdraw ↔ advance(전진하다)를 함께 암기하세요.

questions.passage: Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against (A)[invaders / allies] by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress (B)[emerged / vanished] that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong (C)[displayed / concealed] strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 산성은 침략자에 대한 최후의 방어 수단이었다. 일본 침략 이후 두 양식을 결합한 새로운 유형의 성곽이 등장했다. 수원 화성은 강한 성벽과 방어 시설을 보여주며 동시에 농업, 상업, 주거의 중심지 역할을 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① invaders(침략자) - emerged(등장했다) - displayed(보여주었다): 방어 대상, 새로운 성곽의 탄생, 화성의 특징을 설명
❌ allies(동맹국): 방어 대상은 침략자
❌ vanished(사라졌다): 새로운 유형이 등장한 것
❌ concealed(숨겼다): 강한 방어력을 보여준 것
det.tip: emerge(등장하다) ↔ vanish(사라지다), display(보여주다) ↔ conceal(숨기다)는 자주 출제되는 반의어 쌍입니다.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that ③<u>combined</u> the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural ④<u>slopes</u> of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 산성은 한국의 산지 지형을 이용하여 침략자를 방어했다. 높은 곳에서 싸울 수 있었다는 내용이므로 flat(평평한)은 문맥에 맞지 않는다.

❌ ② flat(평평한) → 원문은 mountainous(산이 많은). 산성은 산지 지형을 활용한 것
✅ ① distinct(구별되는): 적절
✅ ③ combined(결합했다): 적절
✅ ④ slopes(경사면): 적절
det.tip: mountainous(산이 많은) ↔ flat(평평한)은 지형 관련 반의어 쌍입니다. landscape(지형)과 함께 자주 쓰입니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 전쟁이 나면 백성들은 안전을 위해 산성으로 철수했다. danger(위험)가 아니라 safety(안전)가 원문이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ② danger(위험) → 원문은 safety(안전). 전쟁 시 산성으로 피한 것은 안전을 위한 것
✅ ① scarce(부족한): 적절
✅ ③ emerged(등장했다): 적절
✅ ④ commerce(상업): 적절
det.tip: safety(안전) ↔ danger(위험)는 대표적 반의어 쌍입니다. withdraw to ~ for safety는 '안전을 위해 ~로 철수하다'라는 표현입니다.

det.korean: uniqueness(독특함-명사), artfully(교묘하게-부사), defense(방어-명사), effectively(효과적으로-부사) 중 mountainous의 올바른 형태를 고르는 문제.
det.analysis:
① uniqueness: unique(형) → uniqueness(명) ✅
② artfully: artful(형) → artfully(부) ✅
③ defensively: 원문은 defense(명사)이므로 defensively(부사)는 잘못된 어형
④ effectively: effective(형) → effectively(부) ✅
det.tip: defense(명사, 방어) / defensive(형용사, 방어적인) / defensively(부사, 방어적으로) — 문맥에 따라 올바른 품사를 선택하세요.

ch: The fortress is known for its uniqueness. (unique → uniqueness)
It artfully combines two styles. (artful → artfully)
It was used defensively against invaders. (defense → defensively)
They effectively pushed back enemies. (effective → effectively)

questions.passage:
Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.
questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 어형이 잘못된 것은?

det.korean: practical(실용적인-형용사), administrative(행정의-형용사), emergence(출현-명사), agricultural(농업의-형용사) 중 잘못된 어형을 찾는 문제.
det.analysis:
① practical: practice(명) → practical(형) ✅
② administrational: 올바른 형용사형은 administrative. administrational은 존재하지 않는 어형 ❌
③ emergence: emerge(동) → emergence(명) ✅
④ agricultural: agriculture(명) → agricultural(형) ✅
det.tip: administer(관리하다) → administration(행정) → administrative(행정의). '-ive'가 올바른 형용사 접미사입니다.

ch: Living there was not practical. (practice → practical)
The area had administrational offices. (administration → administrational)
The emergence of a new fortress type. (emerge → emergence)
It served as an agricultural center. (agriculture → agricultural)

questions.passage:
Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers.
questions.stem:
다음 글에서 밑줄 친 ground와 같은 의미로 쓰인 것은?
Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies.

det.korean: 방어자들은 더 높은 지대에서 싸울 수 있었다. ground = '땅, 지면, 지대'.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ The house was built on solid ground.(그 집은 단단한 땅 위에 지어졌다): ground = 땅, 지면
❌ ① There are no grounds for complaint.(불만의 근거가 없다): ground = 근거, 이유
❌ ② The plane was grounded due to weather.(비행기가 날씨 때문에 이륙 금지되었다): ground = 이륙 금지시키다
❌ ④ She covered a lot of ground in her speech.(그녀는 연설에서 많은 내용을 다루었다): ground = (다루는) 범위
det.tip: ground의 다의어: ① 땅, 지면 ② 근거, 이유 ③ 이륙 금지시키다 ④ (다루는) 범위. 문맥에 따라 의미를 구별하세요.

ch: There are no grounds for complaint.
The plane was grounded due to weather.
The house was built on solid ground.
She covered a lot of ground in her speech.

questions.passage:
Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress __________ blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 해당하는 영어 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"교묘하게, 솜씨 있게" — 이 성곽은 두 양식을 _______ 융합한다.

det.korean: 원문: This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles
det.analysis:
✅ ① artfully(교묘하게): art(기술, 예술) + -ful + -ly. 솜씨 있게, 교묘하게
❌ ② artificially(인위적으로): 인공적으로라는 뜻
❌ ③ artistically(예술적으로): 예술적으로라는 뜻으로 미묘하게 다름
❌ ④ accidentally(우연히): 의도적 융합과 반대
det.tip: artfully = '교묘하게, 솜씨 있게'. artful(교묘한)에 -ly가 붙은 부사형입니다. artificial(인공적인)과 혼동하지 마세요.

Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong __________ strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 해당하는 영어 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"보여주다, 전시하다" — 수원 화성은 강한 성벽과 방어 시설을 _______.

det.korean: 원문: Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses
det.analysis:
✅ ③ displayed(보여주었다): display = 보여주다, 전시하다
❌ ① disguised(위장했다): 숨기는 것이지 보여주는 것이 아님
❌ ② dismissed(무시했다): 의미 불일치
❌ ④ disrupted(방해했다): 의미 불일치
det.tip: display = '보여주다, 전시하다'. dis- 접두사가 부정을 뜻하지 않는 예외적 단어입니다. disguise(위장하다), dismiss(무시하다)와 혼동하지 마세요.
